writing.overall_comment: The SKILL.md is a clear high-level reference, but it needs deeper TypeScript coverage, more edge-case examples, and more procedural guidance to be fully actionable.

dimensions.name: Semantic accuracy
dimensions.comment: The name and description accurately capture a broad React/Next.js/Tailwind/shadcn skill, though the body mentions TypeScript without giving it substantive coverage.

dimensions.name: Examples & edge cases
dimensions.comment: The two code examples are correct happy-path snippets but do not cover failure paths, loading/error states, or common RSC and hydration edge cases.

dimensions.name: Actionability
dimensions.comment: The document offers useful patterns and best practices but lacks explicit step-by-step workflows or decision criteria for executing common React tasks.

suggestions: In the code examples sections, add failure-path, loading/error-state, and RSC/hydration edge-case examples alongside the current happy-path snippets.
In the React task guidance sections, add explicit step-by-step workflows and decision criteria for common tasks to improve actionability.
